title: frames.parquet
description: One row per frame and player, the ball repeated on each, compressed with zstd. Not a JSON Schema: Parquet columns, in order. Weigh every metric by dt_s, never by counting frames. No platform id in here: player_idx refers to the roster of events.json.

columns.name: dt_s
columns.description: Time since the previous kept frame, 0 on the first.

columns.name: phase
columns.description: 0 unknown, 1 kickoff countdown, 2 waiting for the kickoff touch, 3 live play, 4 after a goal.

columns.name: ball_x
columns.description: Null when the replay has no ball on this frame.

columns.name: player_idx
columns.description: The player's row in the roster of events.json.

columns.name: present
columns.description: False when the player is absent on this frame. Unrelated to demolitions.

columns.name: x
columns.description: Null when not present. Wrong while demolished.

columns.name: vx
columns.description: Can be null even when present: 0.6 % of the samples.

columns.name: demolished
columns.description: From the demolition to the respawn: the car's position is wrong meanwhile.
